nodes.label: subagent-driven-development skill
nodes.rationale: 有计划后激活;每个任务派发全新 subagent 并逐一审查(最彻底);两阶段审查的快速迭代:先规格合规、后代码质量。

nodes.label: Drill Skill-Compliance Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Drill (obra/drill) drives real tmux sessions with an LLM actor and verifier; already the de facto eval harness after the PRI-1397 series lifted ~22 bash tests into drill scenarios.

nodes.label: evals/ Canonical Eval Harness
nodes.rationale: The split is meaningful: tests/ = non-LLM plugin infrastructure (bash/node/python); evals/ = LLM behavior with actor plus verifier on real tmux sessions.

nodes.label: Subagent-Gated Verification Protocol
nodes.rationale: Every change gets cross-checked by an independent subagent before commit (per-file SHA-256 checksums, per-assertion coverage tables, reference scrubbing); the subagent's output is the gate and the trail is auditable in commit messages.

nodes.label: SUPERPOWERS_ROOT Auto-Default
nodes.rationale: After the move, cli.py's PROJECT_ROOT.parent resolves to the repo root; a helper sets the env var when unset, removing the export step from contributor setup.

nodes.label: Cannot-Verify-From-Diff Channel
nodes.rationale: Requirements that cannot be verified from the diff become explicit flagged items the controller must resolve with cross-task context, instead of crawling the codebase or silently passing.

nodes.label: requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md template
nodes.rationale: The broad template for final whole-branch review and ad-hoc review; per-task delegation removed, with an explicit final-review pointer kept so the template is not orphaned.

nodes.label: SDD Durable Progress Ledger
nodes.rationale: Real sessions re-dispatched entire completed task sequences after compaction (269 dispatches for ~22 tasks); the progress.md ledger is the durable record the controller re-anchors on.

nodes.label: task-reviewer-prompt.md (merged spec and quality reviewer)
nodes.rationale: Live eval economics showed per-dispatch overhead dominating cost; merging spec and quality reviews into one reviewer with two verdicts (one reading of the diff, one fix dispatch) beat baseline on every axis.

nodes.label: Task-Scoped Review
nodes.rationale: Per-task quality prompts inherited merge-readiness framing from code-reviewer.md and cost 4-8x spec reviewers on the same tasks; scope per-task reviews to the task while the final whole-branch review stays broad.

nodes.label: Micro-Test Harness for Prompt Guidance
nodes.rationale: One API call per sample at ~0.15-0.30 USD vs 12 USD full eval runs; programmatic scoring with manual inspection of every match; always include a no-guidance control.

nodes.label: writing-plans No Placeholders Section
nodes.rationale: The banned tokens double as the Self-Review scan inventory (the recognition category that works); the micro-test found current opus emits no plan placeholders even under pressure - section left as-is and the V2 relocation design kept on file.

nodes.label: Strict-Cost Experiment Ladder
nodes.rationale: Minimize dollars per plan-execution with quality as the hard invariant (N=5 scenario gates, blind A/B deliverable parity); each rung ships only with gate evidence and any quality regression kills the rung.

nodes.label: L1 Plan-Side Crispness
nodes.rationale: The plan is upstream of every cost (task count sets dispatch count, ambiguity sets review-loop count); measured result: the dollar win belongs to opus-written complete-code plans, while the guidance owns fidelity and variance (deterministic constraints propagation, exact interfaces, fewer fix waves).

nodes.label: L2 Controller Tier Experiment
nodes.rationale: The controller is half the dollars solely because it inherits the session model; died at the gates as pre-registered - cheap controllers escalate explicit conflicts (5/5) but absorb implicit authority-vs-quality adjudication (planted defect shipped 4/5).

nodes.label: L3 Reviewer Tier Experiment
nodes.rationale: Dead as pre-registered: per-task haiku reviewers flagged 0 of 10 planted defects at correct severity - cheap reviewers fail by advocating for defects (DRY praised as YAGNI, assert-nothing test called plan-compliant).

nodes.label: L4 Resident-Context Diet
nodes.rationale: Trim resident context: task-brief list mode (headings plus Global Constraints, never the full plan), 8-line reports, SKILL.md minification - Codex pays ~10k chars times ~500 re-reads per long session.

nodes.label: sdd-escalates-broken-plan Eval Scenario
nodes.rationale: New scenario with an explicit plan self-contradiction the human never volunteers; passed 5/5 at sonnet (opus baseline 2/2) - cheap controllers handle explicit escalation, not implicit adjudication.

nodes.label: Eval Fixture Generator v3
nodes.rationale: v1 fabricated hashes and v2 stub implementations invalidated their own controls; v3 makes every ledger claim survive content inspection - real implementations satisfying each task spec, rotating authors, spread timestamps.

nodes.label: S1 Stale-Ledger Scenario
nodes.rationale: Post-upgrade worst case: a legacy flat ledger with no identity header plus plan A's completed scoped workspace; GREEN controllers resolve structurally (workspace plus identity line) with zero commit-content forensics.

nodes.label: S2 Same-Plan Resume Scenario
nodes.rationale: Protects the ledger's original purpose: tasks 1-2 genuinely implemented and recorded, so a correct controller recognizes them and dispatches Task 3 - the fix must not break legitimate resume.

nodes.label: Ledger Plan-Identity First Line
nodes.rationale: Belt for hand-rolled ledgers: a first line naming the plan makes foreign ledgers detectable without forensics - a ledger naming a different plan is another plan's progress, left in place.

nodes.label: Plan-Scoped SDD Workspace
nodes.rationale: Identity must be structural: any fix relying on end-of-plan cleanup alone fails exactly in the crash/compaction cases the ledger exists to survive; .superpowers/sdd/<plan-slug>/ makes cross-plan collision impossible and stale siblings inert.

nodes.label: review-package Script
nodes.rationale: Gains PLAN_FILE as first argument; diff packages land under the plan's workspace with unique SHA-range collateral names (worktree/submodule-safe).

nodes.label: sdd-workspace Script
nodes.rationale: Resolves and creates the plan's workspace directory; maintains the self-ignoring parent .gitignore; errors on missing argument or nonexistent plan file.

nodes.label: task-brief Script
nodes.rationale: Signature unchanged; the default OUTFILE moves into the plan's workspace via sdd-workspace, so briefs from different plans can never overwrite each other.

nodes.label: Controller Adjudication at Circuit-Breaker Trip
nodes.rationale: The controller holds the plan and cross-task context the reviewer lacks; contested findings are ledgered, load-bearing ones reach the existing BLOCKED stop - no new human checkpoint, and every adjudication is a ledger entry; silent discards stay forbidden.

nodes.label: Fix-Loop Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: Repeat-until-approved with fresh full reviews never converged - a nondeterministic frontier reviewer surfaced new findings every round; five rounds (three resumes of the original implementer, then two fresh dispatches on a more capable model) de-anchor and capability-bump in one move.

nodes.label: Excuse/Reality Rationalization Table
nodes.rationale: Seven sibling skills use the Excuse/Reality table while SDD carried a 17-bullet Never list; excuses get rebuttals and hard rules move to their points of use.

nodes.label: re-review-prompt.md
nodes.rationale: A separate template because the scoped re-review is a different contract - overloading the full-review template produced the current ambiguity.

nodes.label: Scoped Re-Review
nodes.rationale: Fresh full reviews each round are the churn engine; scoped re-reviews (fix-scoped diff package, per-finding verdicts) make the loop structurally convergent while the final whole-branch review remains the broad safety net.

nodes.label: T1: SDD Worker-Review Prohibition
nodes.rationale: 9/9 depth-2 spawns across 4 corpora were implementer-issued reviewers, all same-task duplicates of the review the controller dispatches anyway; self-review in the implementer prompt gets reified into a reviewer subagent on spawn-capable harnesses.

nodes.label: T2: Event-Driven Waiting
nodes.rationale: 60-78 percent of wait_agent calls time out in every corpus; Codex V2 waits are event subscriptions, not polls - one long wait has the same wake latency as a 10s poll at ~1/90th the calls, and completed children drain into the next model request.

nodes.label: T3: codex-tools.md V1/V2 Corrections
nodes.rationale: Five guidance claims are contradicted by the Codex source: close_agent is V1-only (V2 LRU-evicts), followup_task always resumes the implementer, role files DO attach to spawns, full-history forks accept model overrides, and non-V2 presets hard-error.

nodes.label: T4: Brainstorming Three-Path Router
nodes.rationale: The absolute HARD-GATE wording pushed a bounded task to FULL ceremony 5/5 - absolute phrasing suppresses discrimination the model draws natively; the measured waste is the unconditional two-document ritual, so the router scales the artifact (spike/bounded/architectural) while every path keeps human approval.

nodes.label: T5: Explicit Model on Child-Issued Spawns
nodes.norm_label: t5: explicit model on child-issued spawns
nodes.rationale: Root spawns are 100 percent explicit-model but 2/2 child-issued spawns omitted model; model without reasoning_effort resets effort to the MODEL's default - every spawn at every depth sets both, with config.toml defaults as machine-level backstop.

nodes.label: Bash Test Deletion Gate
nodes.rationale: Every bash-test deletion is gated by a subagent that compares each bash assertion to the claimed drill scenario verify block; anything not 100 percent covered is kept.

nodes.label: Reviewer Scope Budget
nodes.rationale: Start from the task diff; read changed files first; inspect adjacent code only for a named concrete risk. Cross-cutting changes are legitimate named risks - gate breadth behind a stated risk, do not forbid it.

nodes.label: Reviewer Test Budget
nodes.rationale: Never re-run tests on code that has not changed: the implementer's report carries TDD RED/GREEN evidence; reviewers verify by reading and run only a focused test when reading raises a specific doubt.

nodes.label: Positive-Instruction Doctrine
nodes.rationale: Measured 2026-06-10: tripwires, recognition tables, and discrete-directive prohibitions work; composition prohibitions backfire when the model has its own agenda (4.4 vs 3.6 control vs 3.0 recipe); nuance clauses dilute winning recipes; ties go to shorter phrasing (Codex re-reads SKILL.md ~500x per long session).

nodes.label: Cheapen-Mechanics-Never-Judgment Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Judgment failures are rare-event, high-blast-radius, and largely invisible to pass/fail gates; every tier change must enumerate which decisions move to a cheaper model and prove each is mechanical, with a judgment audit on top.

nodes.label: SDD Thesis Guardrail (Fresh Subagent Per Task)
nodes.norm_label: sdd thesis guardrail (fresh subagent per task)
nodes.rationale: SDD's thesis is a fresh subagent per task with precisely curated context, gated per task; dispatch-time task batching is counter-thesis (pollutes fresh context, coarsens gates) - the sanctioned route is plan-time task right-sizing.

nodes.label: WebSocket Protocol Layer (RFC 6455 Frame Handling)
nodes.community_name: 分支完成与 Handoff 档案
nodes.rationale: Server frames are never masked; client frames are always masked; protocol functions are exported so they are unit-testable when server.js is required as a module.

nodes.label: Per-Session Secret Key Authentication
nodes.community_name: 分支完成与 Handoff 档案
nodes.rationale: A Host allowlist only defends the loopback browser confused-deputy; a direct remote client just sends the expected Host, so the allowlist is theater for remote exposure. A per-session secret key authenticates clients uniformly across loopback, SSH tunnel, and direct-remote, and also defeats DNS rebinding.

nodes.label: Fallback Token Isolation
nodes.community_name: 分支完成与 Handoff 档案
nodes.rationale: Fallback on EADDRINUSE must not reuse the persisted token — the fallback key must not authenticate to the original server — and must fail closed when BRAINSTORM_TOKEN is explicitly set.

nodes.label: Three-Path Plan Router
nodes.community_name: 分支完成与 Handoff 档案
nodes.rationale: The absolute hard-gate wording forced bounded tasks into the full two-document ritual 5/5 while a no-guidance control differentiated paths natively; ceremony scales with the task, the approval gate never does.

nodes.label: Codex App Finishing Handoff Payload
nodes.rationale: The sandbox blocks checkout -b, push, and gh pr create; the agent commits all work and hands off to the App's native controls (Create branch, Hand off to local) with suggested branch name and commit message.

nodes.label: Read-Only Git Environment Detection
nodes.rationale: Three read-only git commands detect the environment without side effects; git-dir vs git-common-dir identifies a linked worktree and avoids the submodule false positive that show-toplevel would produce; cd plus pwd -P handles relative paths and symlinks.

nodes.label: finishing-a-development-branch skill
nodes.rationale: 任务完成后激活;验证测试、呈现合并/保留/丢弃选项、清理 worktree。

nodes.label: IN_LINKED_WORKTREE Signal
nodes.rationale: GIT_DIR != GIT_COMMON means the agent is in a worktree created by something else (Codex App, Agent tool, previous skill run, or the user).

nodes.label: ON_DETACHED_HEAD Signal
nodes.rationale: Empty branch name means no named branch exists - the agent cannot create branches, push, or open PRs from the sandbox.

nodes.label: Sandbox Fallback Behavior
nodes.rationale: A permission error on git worktree add (e.g. Seatbelt denial) means a late-detected restricted environment: skip creation, run setup and baseline tests in place.

nodes.label: Worktree Hooks Symlinking
nodes.rationale: Git worktrees do not inherit the parent repo's hooks directory; symlinking .git/hooks prevents pre-commit checks from silently stopping (idea from PR #965).

nodes.label: Step 0.5: Worktree Consent
nodes.rationale: Worktree creation becomes opt-in rather than mandatory; skipped entirely when Step 0 detects existing isolation.

nodes.label: Step 0: Detect Existing Isolation
nodes.rationale: A worktree is a worktree regardless of origin; a submodule guard (show-superproject-working-tree) prevents false positives.

nodes.label: Step 1a: Native Worktree Tools (preferred)
nodes.rationale: The abstract wording failed at 2/6 because agents anchored on Step 1b's concrete git commands; explicit tool naming (EnterWorktree, WorktreeCreate, /worktree, --worktree) plus the consent bridge fixed it to 50/50 across GREEN and PRESSURE tests.

nodes.label: Step 1b: Git Worktree Fallback
nodes.rationale: Manual worktree creation for harnesses without native tools: agent-instruction-file preference, then existing .worktrees/, then default; gitignore safety verification; git worktree add -b.

nodes.label: Stale Worktree Pruning
nodes.rationale: Out-of-band deletions leave stale registrations that cause confusing errors; one git worktree prune line after any remove self-heals (idea from PR #1072).

nodes.label: Workspace End-of-Life Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Hygiene, not correctness: after the final review's fix wave merges, the controller deletes its plan's workspace - the record of work is git history; sibling directories and parked cross-plan artifacts are never touched.

nodes.label: Consent-Authorization Bridge
nodes.rationale: Tool descriptions override skill instructions (Claude Code #29950); EnterWorktree guards on explicit user request, so the skill must frame the user's Step 0.5 consent as the authorization the tool requires.

nodes.label: Detect-and-Defer Worktree Strategy
nodes.rationale: Native harness worktree systems already manage paths, lifecycle, and cleanup; defer to them when present and fill the gap when absent. Detect state via git primitives, not platform sniffing - stable since git 2.5 and zero maintenance as new harnesses appear.

nodes.label: Provenance-Based Worktree Ownership
nodes.rationale: Whoever creates the worktree owns its cleanup: paths under .worktrees/ or worktrees/ are superpowers-owned; branded harness paths (.claude/worktrees/, ~/.codex/worktrees/, .gemini/worktrees/) are hands-off.

nodes.label: 测行为,不测文本(Behavior, not text)
nodes.norm_label: 测行为,不测文本(behavior, not text)
nodes.rationale: 断言脚本/技能/配置包含某行只证明源码是源码;对受控输入运行脚本并断言输出、副作用或退出码;指导 agent 的文档由消费方 agent 的行为检验;给人看的散文不配测试。

nodes.label: 测你的边界契约,不测框架(Your code, not the framework)
nodes.norm_label: 测你的边界契约,不测框架(your code, not the framework)
nodes.rationale: 测自己代码在边界上做出的契约(注册的路由、发出的查询、产出的 payload);上游机制是其维护者的测试;上游行为真令人意外时写一个窄的表征测试命名该假设;构造器/getter/常量/平凡转发仅在校验、规范化、默认、推导、强制或副作用时才配测试。

nodes.label: 完整镜像真实数据(Mirror real data completely)
nodes.norm_label: 完整镜像真实数据(mirror real data completely)
nodes.rationale: 按现实存在的完整结构(所有已文档化字段)mock,而非只 mock 测试读的字段;部分 mock 在下游读到缺失字段时静默失败:测试通过而集成挂掉。

nodes.label: 原则 2:每个测试锻炼真实对象(Exercise the Real Thing)
nodes.norm_label: 原则 2:每个测试锻炼真实对象(exercise the real thing)
nodes.rationale: 先写并看着对真实代码失败的测试已证明它能失败;只有当真实依赖被证明慢或外部时,才赢得一个 mock。

nodes.label: 门函数 2:加 mock 或测试辅助前的检查
nodes.norm_label: 门函数 2:加 mock 或测试辅助前的检查
nodes.rationale: 列出真实方法的副作用,保持测试依赖的副作用真实——只 mock 其下慢/外部层级;mock 响应镜像完整真实结构;只被测试调用的方法放进测试工具;要断言 mock 本身→解除或删掉断言。

nodes.label: 门函数 1:写测试体前的检查
nodes.norm_label: 门函数 1:写测试体前的检查
nodes.rationale: 命名会让测试失败的生产变更:说不出→围绕可观察行为重新设计;'源码文本变了'→运行产物断言其效果;只有有意决策→变更探测器,测依赖该决策的行为;确认期望值不经被测代码推导,否则换成字面量或手工校验 fixture。

nodes.label: 独立推导期望值(字面量与手工校验 fixture)
nodes.norm_label: 独立推导期望值(字面量与手工校验 fixture)
nodes.rationale: 用被测代码或其辅助函数算出的期望无论代码做什么都会通过;表驱动测试加字面量 want 值是首选形态;镜像断言(同一 builder 算两边)恒真。

nodes.label: mock 不配拥有断言(The mock earns no assertions)
nodes.norm_label: mock 不配拥有断言(the mock earns no assertions)
nodes.rationale: mock 断言在 mock 存在时通过、缺失时失败,对组件本身什么都没说;断言真实组件的行为,否则解除 mock 或删掉断言;'Are we testing the behavior of a mock?'

nodes.label: 在正确的层级 mock(Mock at the right level)
nodes.norm_label: 在正确的层级 mock(mock at the right level)
nodes.rationale: 替换前先弄清真实方法的全部副作用;mock 慢的或外部的操作,保持测试依赖的部分真实;不确定时先对真实实现跑测试观察实际需要什么。

nodes.label: 变异检查(The Mutation Check)
nodes.rationale: 收尾前在心里变异生产代码,每个现实变异至少一个测试失败:错误常量/参数、错误分支处理、缺失状态变更或副作用、空/默认返回、缺失对零/空/nil/未授权/畸形输入的校验;没有测试捕获的变异标记该行为未受保护——或该测试是同义反复。

nodes.label: 原则 1:每个测试命名它捕获的破坏(Name the Break)
nodes.norm_label: 原则 1:每个测试命名它捕获的破坏(name the break)
nodes.rationale: 写测试体前先回答:什么生产变更应让此测试失败,该变更是 bug 还是决策;测试靠捕获错误分支、缺失副作用、错误参数、边界情形或破坏的契约来赢得位置;严格 TDD 自然产出两条原则。

nodes.label: 禁止变更探测器(No change detectors)
nodes.norm_label: 禁止变更探测器(no change detectors)
nodes.rationale: 只有有意决策才能让其失败的测试(常量值、精确文案、私有结构)在重新设计时误报、在 bug 时沉睡;测依赖该决策的行为,而非决策本身。

nodes.label: 真实组件优于复杂 mock(Prefer real components over complex mocks)
nodes.norm_label: 真实组件优于复杂 mock(prefer real components over complex mocks)
nodes.rationale: 当 mock 设置超过测试逻辑、mock 缺真实组件的方法、或 mock 变动导致测试挂掉时,切换为使用真实组件的集成测试;'Do we need to be using a mock here?'

nodes.label: 生产类只携带生产方法(Production classes carry production methods only)
nodes.norm_label: 生产类只携带生产方法(production classes carry production methods only)
nodes.rationale: 只有测试需要的清理放在测试工具里,绝不作为生产类上的 destroy();问:这个方法只被测试调用吗?这个类拥有该资源的生命周期吗?答案为否→测试工具。

nodes.label: 让替身具体化(Make doubles specific)
nodes.norm_label: 让替身具体化(make doubles specific)
nodes.rationale: 参数、调用次数或顺序属于契约时要断言它们;接受任何东西的假对象验证不了任何东西;给每个分支(成功/错误/畸形)各自的 fixture 或 spy,让错误分支无法满足期望。

nodes.label: 测试与实现一起交付(Tests ship with the implementation)
nodes.norm_label: 测试与实现一起交付(tests ship with the implementation)
nodes.rationale: TDD 循环(失败测试→最小实现→重构)就是'完成'的含义;交付行为需要的测试且仅这些:平凡代码和人类散文不配测试,为满足流程而写的测试永远花维护成本。

nodes.label: 警示信号清单(Warning Signs)
nodes.rationale: setup 与断言共享同一对象保证相等;测试只能通过 panic/崩溃/缺失选择器失败;每次有意变更都失败而意外破坏从不失败;期望值藏在循环/builder/辅助函数后;grep 源文本或断言已删除符号保持删除;只剩框架时测试仍然成立;只为覆盖率存在;断言 *-mock test ID 或移除 mock 即失败;方法只被测试文件调用;mock 设置超过测试一半或解释不了为何需要 mock;为保险而 mock。

nodes.label: Architectural 路径
nodes.rationale: 新项目、新子系统、改接口属 architectural:走完整流程(提问、2-3 个方案权衡、分段设计、书面 spec、自审、用户审查),然后唯一允许的下一步是 writing-plans。

nodes.rationale: Never fight the harness: detect existing isolation first, then defer to the platform's native worktree tools, and fall back to manual git worktrees only when no native tool is available.

nodes.label: Provenance-Based Worktree Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Only worktrees under .worktrees/ or worktrees/ are superpowers-created and safe to remove; anything else is owned by the host environment and removing it causes phantom state.

nodes.label: Testing Skills Framework (RED/GREEN/PRESSURE)
nodes.rationale: Skills are behavior-shaping prose, not code; RED confirms current behavior, GREEN verifies the new text changes agent behavior, PRESSURE tests resistance to skip rationalizations.

nodes.label: Task-Scoped Review Protocol
nodes.rationale: Per-task reviews are task-scoped gates: start from the diff, read code outside it only for a named risk, never re-run the implementer's tests; the broad whole-branch review happens once at the end.

nodes.label: Plan-Scoped Workspace Directory (.superpowers/sdd/<plan-stem>/)
nodes.rationale: One directory per plan so a follow-up plan can never read or overwrite another plan's artifacts; a stale ledger misread as current progress makes controllers skip whole task sequences. The workspace lives in the working tree (not .git/) because Claude Code denies agent writes under .git/, and a self-ignoring .gitignore keeps it out of git status.

nodes.label: Five-Round Circuit Breaker
nodes.rationale: Past the cap, rounds don't converge — the failure is structural. Adjudicate only at the cap (adjudicating earlier is pre-judging with a different name) and every adjudication is a ledger entry; silent discards are forbidden.

nodes.label: Resume-First Fix Rounds (1-3 Resume, 4-5 Fresh Implementer)
nodes.norm_label: resume-first fix rounds (1-3 resume, 4-5 fresh implementer)
nodes.rationale: Rounds 1-3 resume the original implementer because its context is intact — it knows the task, the code, and its own choices; a loop that survives three resumes usually means the implementer cannot see its own problem, so rounds 4-5 bring fresh eyes and a capability bump in one move.

nodes.label: Event-Driven Child Waiting
nodes.rationale: Long waits eliminated timeouts (65.1% to 0.0%) but produced 20-38 min silent transcripts and let one child in 51 vanish unnoticed; bounded 5-10 min stretches with a status line and list_agents reconcile keep the efficiency and restore observability.

nodes.label: Worker Review Prohibition
nodes.rationale: Depth-2 worker-spawned reviewers were 9/9 same-task duplicate reviews across four corpora — every reviewer a worker spawned duplicated the task review the controller dispatched anyway, at full cost.

nodes.label: Read-Only Preflight Manifest Validation
nodes.rationale: A deterministic YAML failure must not occur after earlier JSON manifests are already updated; one read-only preflight validates required tools and reads every present declared manifest before any write.

nodes.label: Approval gates (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: No archive before the partner has seen the scrub log and file list; no issue or comment before they approve the exact text.

nodes.label: Case workspace (~/.superpowers/diagnosing-superpowers/<session-id>/)
nodes.rationale: One per-session home for the case file, report, and issue drafts; the partner is told the path up front.

nodes.label: Dispatch or inline (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: Where a step says dispatch, use a subagent tool if available; otherwise run that prompt yourself — keeps analyst, scrub, and similar-session prompts runnable in inline-only environments.

nodes.label: Exact paths to subagents (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: A subagent's 'current session' is its own — pass absolute paths and ids or the analyst reads the wrong session.

nodes.label: Export (workflow step 6)
nodes.rationale: Never build a bundle unprompted — it is the partner's session data, packaged; scrub then audit repeat until the audit returns CLEAN, and archive only after approval.

nodes.label: GitHub issues (workflow step 5)
nodes.rationale: Search open and closed issues for the symptoms first; create an issue only after the partner approves the exact text — gh cannot attach files, so the partner attaches the bundle in the browser.

nodes.label: Human prompts only (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: Hook output, system reminders, and tool results are not the partner's words; in a subagent transcript 'user' is the parent agent.

nodes.label: Intake before analysis (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: An unscoped sweep spends the budget on the wrong question; a statement reconstructed for the partner is not an answer.

nodes.label: Locate (workflow step 2)
nodes.rationale: Resolve sessions to verified absolute paths; confirm a past session by quoting its first prompt and timestamp, and list every rejected candidate with the reason.

nodes.label: No superpowers diagnosis (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: Report §7 states involvement and stops — never name a defect in a skill or propose a change; partner pressure does not waive this.

nodes.label: Every finding cites path:line (core principle)
nodes.rationale: No citation, no finding — every number comes from the transcript or from a command you ran, never from memory.

nodes.label: Problem intake (workflow step 1)
nodes.rationale: 'It took too long' is a complaint, not a problem statement — the statement naming sessions, turn range, expectation, and the observable scopes everything downstream.

nodes.label: Quick reference (complaint to lead-with analysts)
nodes.rationale: All seven analysts always run — the table only picks which region to read yourself in step 3 and which findings to lead with.

nodes.label: Read-only (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: Session files are the evidence under investigation; never modify, move, or delete one.

nodes.label: Red Flags table
nodes.rationale: Rationalization guard: each tempting thought is countered by the reality that protects the workflow (e.g. 'The price per token is well known' — numbers you did not compute are invented; cite or drop).

nodes.label: Bundle redaction levels (skeleton / evidence / full)
nodes.rationale: Partner chooses the level knowing what each includes: skeleton (no tool-result bodies), evidence (bodies only for cited events), full.

nodes.label: Report (workflow step 4)
nodes.rationale: Fill every section of the report in order and check what cited content actually proves; a symlink alias is not a redundant copy.

nodes.label: Similar sessions (workflow step 7)
nodes.rationale: Turn confirmed findings into a signature, list candidates by mtime and size, and check each in parallel to find recurrence.

nodes.label: Triage (workflow step 3)
nodes.rationale: Read the region around the reported problem yourself, then run one analyst per dimension in parallel; discard any finding without path:line and split dimensions by turn range on long transcripts.

nodes.label: diagnosing-superpowers (SKILL.md)
nodes.rationale: Pin down what went wrong, read the transcripts on disk, and report with evidence; you report — you do not diagnose superpowers. Whoever triages the bundle or the issue decides whether superpowers changes.

nodes.label: Real-World Debugging Session (2025-10-03)
nodes.rationale: All three supporting-technique docs cite this single session (empty projectDir / git init bug, 15 flaky tests fixed, 1847 tests passing) as the evidence base from which root-cause-tracing, defense-in-depth, and condition-based-waiting were distilled.

nodes.label: Dual-mode review (dispatch subagent or self-review)
nodes.rationale: With a subagent tool, dispatch a general-purpose reviewer with an explicitly specified most-capable model (a judgment task); without one, perform the code-reviewer.md review yourself as a separate pass — a self-review by the author is weaker than a fresh reviewer, and the human partner decides whether that is enough before merge.

nodes.label: Push back on wrong reviewer feedback
nodes.norm_label: push back on wrong reviewer feedback
nodes.rationale: If the reviewer is wrong, push back with technical reasoning, show code/tests that prove it works, or request clarification — never argue with valid technical feedback.

nodes.label: Review early, review often (core principle)
nodes.rationale: Get a code review before issues cascade; tests prove the code does what you meant, review asks whether what you meant is what the plan requires — different question, different gate.

nodes.label: Review range (BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA)
nodes.rationale: BASE_SHA from git merge-base main HEAD (or HEAD~1) and HEAD_SHA from git rev-parse HEAD bound the diff handed to the reviewer.

nodes.label: Severity levels (Critical/Important/Minor)
nodes.rationale: Fix Critical issues immediately, fix Important before proceeding, note Minor for later — severity gates how feedback is acted on.

nodes.label: code-reviewer.md (review template)
nodes.rationale: The reviewer works from precisely crafted context — the diff, the plan, the requirements — never the session's history; that keeps the review on the work product, not the author's thought process.

nodes.label: Four-Phase Debugging Framework
nodes.rationale: Investigation, Pattern Analysis, Hypothesis, Implementation - extracted from CLAUDE.md debugging rules. Phase 1 is mandatory before any fix so implementation cannot skip investigation; each phase gates the next.

nodes.label: The Iron Law: No Fixes Without Root Cause Investigation
nodes.norm_label: the iron law: no fixes without root cause investigation
nodes.rationale: Core principle: ALWAYS find root cause before attempting fixes; symptom fixes are failure. Absolute language (ALWAYS/NEVER, 'even if faster', 'even if I seem in a hurry') was deliberately chosen to resist time pressure and rationalization.

nodes.label: Single Hypothesis Rule
nodes.rationale: Structural defense: forming and testing exactly one hypothesis forces thinking and prevents shotgun fixes; test the smallest possible change, one variable at a time.

nodes.label: Question Architecture After 3+ Failed Fixes
nodes.rationale: 3+ failed fixes indicate a wrong architecture rather than a failed hypothesis: stop, question fundamentals, and discuss with your human partner before attempting fix #4.

nodes.label: Diagnosed Session Case File
nodes.rationale: Central shared data artifact of the diagnosing-superpowers workflow: the matcher and both analyst dimensions all rely on the case file's context-safety rules, discovered record meanings, and extraction commands rather than re-deriving them per prompt.

nodes.label: Context safety (hard rule)
nodes.rationale: One transcript line can be a megabyte — follow references/context-safety.md on every session file, every time.

nodes.label: cost-and-time.md Cost and Time Analyst Prompt
nodes.norm_label: cost-and-time.md cost and time analyst prompt

nodes.label: Transcript Context Safety Rules
nodes.rationale: One transcript line can exceed a megabyte; counts and line numbers first, then small fields from specific lines — never cat or grep a transcript for content.

nodes.label: No-Diagnosis Reporting Rule
nodes.rationale: The skill reports involvement only — whether superpowers needs a change is decided by whoever triages the bundle or the GitHub issue; every finding must cite path:line and the skill never names a defect or proposes a change.

nodes.label: Spec Document Reviewer

nodes.rationale: 12 条合理化念头与现实对照(如'这只是个简单问题'→问题即任务,检查技能;'我记得这个技能'→技能会演进,读当前版本;'这个技能是杀鸡用牛刀'→简单事变复杂,用它);出现这些念头意味着 STOP——你在合理化。

nodes.label: .events Per-Screen Event Stream
nodes.rationale: Server appends user events as JSON lines to $SCREEN_DIR/.events so the agent reads the full exploration path on its next turn; cleared when a new screen is pushed; replaces blocking event delivery.

nodes.label: helper.js client script
nodes.rationale: Keeps WebSocket reconnect and toggleSelect; removes sendToClaude and window.send; click capture narrowed to [data-choice] because the browser is now only a selection tracker.

nodes.label: Selection Indicator Bar
nodes.rationale: Replaces the removed feedback footer; guides the user back to the terminal after clicking an option.

nodes.rationale: Platform-adaptive layer of the companion: the terminal message is primary feedback; .events provides the browser interaction stream as context.

nodes.label: wait-for-feedback.sh (deleted script)
nodes.rationale: Bridged server stdout events to the agent via a blocking background task; deleted entirely because the .events file lets the agent read interactions with platform-native file reads.

nodes.label: wrapInFrame Comment-Placeholder Injection
nodes.rationale: The old regex anchored on the removed feedback-footer div; a single comment placeholder makes injection simpler and resilient to template formatting changes.

nodes.label: fs.watch File Watching
nodes.rationale: Replaces chokidar; reliable for single flat directories on macOS, Linux, and Windows; ~100ms per-filename debounce prevents duplicate events.

nodes.label: RFC 6455 WebSocket Protocol Implementation
nodes.rationale: Text frames only; binary frames, fragmentation, extensions, and subprotocols deliberately skipped - unnecessary for small JSON messages between localhost clients, and unadvertised extensions are never active.

nodes.label: .server-info Connection File
nodes.rationale: Startup JSON written to the screen directory so agents can find connection details when stdout is hidden by background execution.

nodes.label: Zero-Dependency server.js
nodes.rationale: Vendored node_modules (express, ws, chokidar; 714 tracked files) is a supply-chain risk: frozen deps get no patches and unaudited code looks like normal commits; one file on Node built-ins eliminates it. Run directly it starts the server; required it exports protocol functions for tests.

nodes.label: Bootstrap Keyed Loads
nodes.rationale: The session key must not remain in the visible URL (history, referrers, same-origin script access); GET /?key= returns a bootstrap page that stores the key in tab-scoped sessionStorage and navigates to a bare /.

nodes.label: /files/* Realpath Containment
nodes.rationale: Symlinks under content/ can point outside the directory, including to state/server-info with the keyed URL; a realpath boundary (file must be a descendant of the real content dir) rejects escapes with 404.

nodes.label: Leak-Reduction Headers
nodes.rationale: Conservative headers (no-referrer, no-store, X-Frame-Options DENY, frame-ancestors none, CORP same-origin) without a restrictive script-src CSP - the companion injects inline helper JS and future screens may load same-origin vendored libraries.

nodes.label: sessionStorage Reconnect Credential
nodes.rationale: The helper needs a reconnect credential that survives same-port restarts and does not depend only on cookie behavior (headed Chrome stopped presenting the cookie after restart).

nodes.label: WebSocket Same-Origin Enforcement
nodes.rationale: A cross-origin localhost page can open a cookie-authenticated WebSocket and write attacker-controlled choices; upgrades must pass both session auth and an Origin match against the request target host.

nodes.label: Root Screen Containment
nodes.rationale: The root GET / screen-selection path could serve symlink or hardlink escapes; getNewestScreen() applies the same realpath guard as /files/* plus a link-count rejection (nlink must be exactly 1).

nodes.label: Stop-Server Instance-ID Ownership Proof
nodes.rationale: Signaling an unrelated node process is worse than leaving a stale process running; start-server passes an inert instance-id argv and stop-server signals only on an exact full-token argv match - fail closed on any ambiguity.
